aluminum_bulk_modulus.name: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
aluminum_bulk_modulus.description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.
